title: [synthetic] zephyrcache eviction stalls node drain
body:
Synthetic fixture issue. When zephyrcache eviction runs during a node drain, the drain stalls. zephyrcache eviction holds the drain until the eviction timeout; node drain never completes while zephyrcache eviction is pending.

{noformat}
I1201 12:00:00.000001 1 drain.go:101] evicting pod synthetic/zephyrcache-0
W1201 12:00:30.000001 1 drain.go:140] zephyrcache eviction still pending, drain stalled
W1201 12:01:00.000001 1 drain.go:140] zephyrcache eviction still pending, drain stalled
E1201 12:05:00.000001 1 drain.go:160] node drain timed out waiting for zephyrcache eviction
{noformat}

comments.body: Synthetic reply: the drain waits on the eviction budget.
